comments.body:
The f45 and rawhide TF jobs look like infra issues. Also reported as a support request. I suspect one possible issue might be the vendor change not being included in v6.1 https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29620/changes .

Let's ignore those for now. We have tests passing on f43 and f44

Yes we can ignore tmt, though the machine-os release was not pushed yet, there was some CI infra failure, or at least it had no logs, I rerun it https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman-machine-os/actions/runs/33642285107

only once podman-machine-os is released we should merge/push the tag here
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman-machine-os/releases/tag/v6.1.1 is released this is good to go
